description: This file defines the ViewMyLeaveEntitlementController class within the OrangeHRM Leave module. It extends functionality from ViewLeaveEntitlementController and uses traits for permission and authentication handling. The main method preRender prepares a Vue.js component for rendering the user's leave entitlements, setting permissions and properties related to leave types and periods.

classes.name: ViewMyLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing the display of the logged-in employee's leave entitlements within the Leave module, utilizing Vue components and permission controls.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the leave entitlement view by initializing a Vue component, adding leave type and period properties, setting permissions, and rendering the component.
